why: Fix the TestRunner statements the unit 03 review found false against the code: screenshot file names (F2), the Reflect-only rule (F3), the base-game fixture (F10).

ops.body: `results.jsonl` fields are lower camel case: `id`, `assembly`, `class`, `method`, `name`, `layer`, `status`, `message`, `stack`, `durationSeconds`, `gameSeconds`, `logErrors`, `notes`. Statuses are lower case words: `pass`, `fail`, `error`, `timeout`, `skipped`. Screenshots are `artifacts/<Assembly>.<Class>.<Method>-<name>.png`.

- C# files are PascalCase and named for the main type they hold (`Session.cs`, `Harness.cs`, `FixtureArea.cs`). `Patches.cs` holds every patch class; `Kit/` holds one file per kit area (`Dupes.cs`, `Tools.cs`, `World.cs`, `OniAssert.cs`, `TestContext.cs`, `Attributes.cs`, `SaveFile.cs`).
- Scripts use PowerShell Verb-Noun names: `Invoke-OniTests.ps1`, `Watch-OniGame.ps1`.
- The mod's folder, assembly (`TestRunner`) and deployed folder share one name. `mod.yaml` carries `staticID: "Isochronous.TestRunner"`; the title is "Test Runner (dev tool)".
- The launcher picks the fixture by the game's current mode: `fixtures/testbed-so.sav` for Spaced Out, `fixtures/testbed-base.sav` for base game. Only `testbed-so.sav` is supplied (it is tracked in common). A base-game run needs `testbed-base.sav` copied into `fixtures/` or a `-Fixture <path>` argument; without one the launcher throws `Fixture save not found`.
- Run folders are `runs/<label>-<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>/` (ignored by `common/.gitignore`) holding `tests/`, `check/<Mod>/`, `fixture.sav`, `results.jsonl`, `results.jsonl.status`, `summary.txt`, `Player.log`, `mods.json.used`, `mods.json.real` and `artifacts/`. The label is short and names the work (`bs-cleanup`, `bs-bao`).
- The live session folder is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\IsochronousOniTests\live` (with `queue`, `state`, `game.pid`); the warden's log sits next to it.
- A mod's test project is `src/<Mod>.Tests/<Mod>.Tests.csproj`; its assembly is `<Mod>.Tests`.

The kit and the tests reach game internals only through `Reflect.cs`: a `public static readonly FieldInfo` per member from `AccessTools`, with a `///` summary saying what it is for, and a line in `Reflect.SelfCheck()`. `FieldInfo` is used and `FieldRefAccess` is not, because a `FieldRef` dynamic method cannot be built on the CoreCLR host that ModCheck runs on.

The harness has two exceptions. `Worldgen.cs` reads `CharacterSelectionController.proceedButton` and `WattsonMessage.button` with its own `AccessTools.Field` calls (`ProceedButton`, `WattsonButton`), and `SelfCheck` does not list them. `Mod.cs` resolves `App.Restart` and `Application.Quit` with `AccessTools.Method` for the quit trace, applied by hand through `TracePatch`. TODO(owner): move the two `Worldgen.cs` fields into `Reflect.cs` and `SelfCheck`.

| Path | Holds |
|------|-------|
| `Mod.cs` | `TestRunnerMod`: command line at load, crash-reporter flags, assembly resolve, quit tracing |
| `Session.cs` | `Session` (command line, test discovery, results, live-session queue), `TestCase`, `TestResult`, `Json` |
| `TestBehaviour.cs` | the driver that steps each test, `LogCapture` |
| `Patches.cs` | the Harmony patches |
| `Harness.cs` | the global switches a run throws |
| `FixtureArea.cs` | choosing and clearing the test area |
| `Worldgen.cs` | tests in a generated world |
| `Reflect.cs` | the private game members the kit and tests touch |
| `Diagnostics.cs` | opt-in grid-mark tracing |
| `Kit/` | the test kit |
| `Invoke-OniTests.ps1`, `Watch-OniGame.ps1` | launcher and warden |
| `fixtures/` | fixture saves and their README |

**Description**: `Reflect` is the list of private game members the kit and tests use, with `SelfCheck`; `Worldgen.cs` reads two buttons with its own `AccessTools.Field` calls. `Diagnostics` traces the grid marks the game makes during tests (`--onitest-trace=1`).  
**Location**: `Reflect.cs`, `Diagnostics.cs`

| Abbreviation | Full Term | Context |
|--------------|-----------|---------|
| ONI | Oxygen Not Included | the game |
| SO | Spaced Out | the expansion; its mode loads `testbed-so.sav`, the only fixture supplied |
| HUD | heads-up display | the driver waits up to 60 s for it before the first test |
| DLL | test assembly | `<Mod>.Tests.dll`, copied to `DIR/tests` |

**Definition**: the save a run loads: `fixtures/testbed-so.sav` in Spaced Out mode (the only fixture supplied), `fixtures/testbed-base.sav` in base-game mode (copy it in first), or the `-Fixture` path: sandbox on, no Duplicants, revealed map. Tests never change the file; the launcher copies it into the run folder.  
**Used in**: `Session.Continue`, the launcher.
